0022600018.text: The Philadelphia 76ers (4-1, first in the Atlantic) host the New York Knicks (2-3, fourth in the Atlantic and two games back) in the 76ers' sixth game of the season, an Emirates NBA Cup East Group B matchup, with Philadelphia on a one-game winning streak and New York on two straight wins. The 76ers are 2-1 at home and 2-0 on the road, the Knicks are 1-2 at home and 1-1 on the road, and Philadelphia leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 106-100 win in New York on October 20. Philadelphia is missing Ariel Hukporti (out, Achilles surgery), Dominick Barlow (out, back fracture) and Tacko Fall (out, quadriceps strain), and Jabari Walker is day-to-day with knee soreness and listed as a game-time decision, while New York is without Jose Alvarado (out, ankle sprain).
